thread:
Ethan: Need to pick a GA default for "launch-safe capacity" for Dedicated reserved pools. Customer asks: prevent sudden throttles during product launches. Options: a) conservative buffer baseline + static prewarm, b) elastic short-term buffer with repayment, c) admissions-based launch mode. Pros/cons?

Ravi: Ops: (a) simplest but costly. (b) like a cushion + repayment window works but needs clear eviction order. (c) admissions mode is safest for us: require customers to opt into a launch window and we treat it as scheduled workload with temporary priority.

Nora: Product: customers want low-friction. Requiring opt-in for (c) may block small teams. Suggest hybrid: default = elastic short-term buffer (60m/month free) + an optional "Launch Mode" opt-in that grants more burst for a defined window with SLA tradeoffs.

Isabel: From runtime: elastic buffer needs allocator and TTL on borrowed capacity. If we set repayment 12h default, reclaiming can cause cold starts. We should pair repayment with prewarm triggers for any tenant that used >20% of buffer for >5m.

Ethan: Good point. Also need billing model: prefer monthly cap rather than per-minute surcharge. Sales says per-minute is a hard no.

Ravi: Runbook additions: alert when buffer borrow >50% for >10m; escalation only if >2h sustained. Eviction order: background jobs -> batch transforms -> low-priority models -> then reserved replicas. Document that in runbook.

Nora: Console UX: show "launch-safe quota" meter, allow customers to request a Launch Mode window (start/end, expected qps), require acceptance of waiver and optional paid upgrade.

Isabel: Implementation note: mark borrowed capacity as "soft-lease" with origin tag. Router will prefer compat-fallback models when soft-lease reclaimed. Add chaos tests for simultaneous launch windows in a region.

Ethan: Proposal to decide: GA default = elastic short-term buffer with monthly free cap 60m, repayment window 12h, prewarm on sustained >20% use for >5m, and opt-in Launch Mode for scheduled windows with explicit waiver. Owners: Isabel->runtime hooks, Ravi->runbook/alerts, Nora->console+pricing, Ethan->contracts. Decision by Friday.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-epic "launch-safe-capacity-defaults" assigned to @Ethan,@Isabel,@Ravi,@Nora due 2025-04-11

Ravi: I'll add the eviction order and alerts to the runbook today.

Isabel: I'll start a small prototype for the soft-lease allocator and prewarm signal. ETA 2w.

Nora: I'll draft the Console mocks and sales FAQ.

Ethan: If no objections, we'll lock this as the GA default on Friday. :thumbsup:
